tools.name: check_road
tools.description: Call before acting on a website or API. Returns the live condition other agents reported in the last few minutes (clear, slow, rate_limited, wall, changed, broken, or unknown when nobody has reported yet), a traffic light, plain-language advice, ranked legitimate detours, and any official notice fro

tools.name: report_road
tools.description: Call after acting on a road, whatever happened, so the next agent knows. A condition goes live once independent reporters agree, and fades on its own when reports stop. Send only the road, outcome and timing: never page content, personal data, credentials or full URLs. Include a detour when you foun

tools.name: watch_road
tools.description: Get a signed webhook POST whenever a road changes light (green, amber, red). Needs a key on LaneRouter Pro; up to 25 watches per key. Returns the watch id, used by unwatch_road, and a signing secret shown only once: verify each delivery’s LaneRouter-Signature header with it. Watching the same road w

tools.name: unwatch_road
tools.description: Delete one of your watches. Its webhook stops immediately and its delivery log is removed; this cannot be undone, but you can create a new watch with watch_road. Get the id from list_watches or from the watch_road result. Returns an error if no watch with that id belongs to your key. Needs a key.

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List every road your key watches, with each watch’s id, webhook url, current light, whether it is active, and its last delivery. Use the id with unwatch_road. Needs a key. To check a road’s live condition, use check_road instead.

tools.name: red_lights
tools.description: List every road that is red right now (agents walled off or the service broken), with its condition, since when, and a link. Use it to plan a multi-step task around known trouble; use check_road for the full conditions, advice and detours of one road. Works without a key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: watch_road, list_watches · Private data: report_road, watch_road · Public sink: report_road, watch_road, unwatch_road, list_watches · Destructive: unwatch_road.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: watch_road, list_watches · Private data: report_road, watch_road · Public sink: report_road, watch_road, unwatch_road, list_watches · Destructive: unwatch_road

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
